keySentence: Real adventure needs courage — Tom had more than anyone knew.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom found light in the cave. They found the treasure. Tom was a hero. Real adventure needs courage Tom had more than anyone knew.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom spotted a tiny beam of light deep inside the dark cave. Following it, they discovered Injun Joe's treasure chest of gold. The boys carried the heavy chest out into the bright sunshine. Real adventure needs courage and Tom had more than anyone knew. The whole town celebrated the two brave boys and their treasure. Tom proved that courage and determination can lead to great things.
